title: Incident Response & Runbook: High Error Rate
text:
This runbook outlines the steps to diagnose and remediate high 5xx error rates in the Enterprise AIOps Orchestrator.




Check Health Probes:

Verify /health/live and /health/ready endpoints.

Inspect Container Logs:

Run docker logs -f <container_id> to check for unhandled exceptions.

Verify Metrics:

Access Prometheus metrics at /metrics to identify spiking endpoints or latency bottlenecks.

title: Aether Sovereign Fabric
text:
Welcome to the official documentation for the The Mark Intelligence Group (TMIG) Aether Sovereign AIOps platform running on native Apple Silicon M4 Max hardware.



Aether Cognition (AX): Local MLX inference and runtime pipelines.
Aether Govern (AG): WORM state ledgers, IAM, and policy enforcement.
Aether Compute (AC): Low-level telemetry and execution gateways.
